status: All seven farm, hatchery, workshop and arena tier sprites generated with built-in image_gen.imagegen. PNG sources in art/realms/buildings; runtime WebP images in public/realms/buildings, active through buildingTiers.ts.
framing: Save the PNG under art/realms/buildings/, then run python scripts/realms-images.py. The game draws each sprite into a 220x220 box and finds the ground plate itself (its widest row), lining the plate's left and right corners up with the 3x3 footprint. Keep the plate full-width and horizontally centered, with transparent space around the building.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE standalone isometric building sprite for Dino Realms pixel art game. Detailed deliberate crisp PIXEL ART, square pixel clusters, stepped shading and dark outlines, limited palette, no smooth painting or blur. Classic 2:1 isometric view matching a 3x3 tile footprint: the building stands on a diamond-shaped ground plate about 80% of the canvas width, centered horizontally, plate center at 78% of the canvas height. Square 1024x1024 canvas, transparent background, NO sky, NO surrounding scenery, NO text or UI, NO characters. Top-left lighting. Subject: an upgraded prehistoric farm, tier 2 of 3: larger fenced field of tilled soil rows with ferns, cicada cages and ginkgo saplings, a sturdy wooden barn with a thatched roof, a small water trough, warm wood and green palette consistent with a friendly fantasy dinosaur world, clearly bigger and richer than a simple starter field
